comments.author: fisj
comments.body:
Thought this was interesting for game UI possibilities. I've been testing flux for photographic stuff, but its prompt adherence is so good its suitable for game UI, design mockups etc.

If you haven't been keeping track of the gen AI image generation space in the last 2 weeks, take some time to catch up on the new flux model.

Catch: only the schnell model has a commercial license.
